import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { socialLinks } from "../../../backend/schema/social_links";

export const socialLinksCms = customizeTable<typeof socialLinks>("social_links", {
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    display: {
        title: "url"
    },
    fields: {
        url: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "url", "user", "createdAt", "updatedAt"]
});
